principles.title: Separate problem from execution
principles.detail: Record scientific question, source, Hamiltonian or circuit, solver and evidence as separate versioned elements.

principles.title: Independent classical baselines
principles.detail: Compare numerical results against exact diagonalization or a suitable classical chemistry/optimization reference.

principles.title: Measure uncertainty and noise
principles.detail: Separate finite-shot uncertainty, hardware or simulated noise, and model approximation error.

principles.title: Repeatable and falsifiable experiments
principles.detail: Pin source, input hash, engine version, seed, circuit, geometry, basis and test tolerances.

principles.title: Fail closed on data rights and safety
principles.detail: No patient data, licensed pharmaceutical datasets, third-party model egress or regulated decisions in unapproved research.

principles.title: Human-gated promotion
principles.detail: A validated schema or passing CI cannot grant clinical, customer, source-rights or production authority.

modules.title: Quantum Experiment Workspace
modules.description: Bounded two-qubit Bell-state reference using an optional local Cirq installation; simulations are not hardware measurements.

modules.title: Molecular Simulation Lab
modules.description: OpenFermion chemistry Hamiltonians and independent classical reference are planned; no H2 calculation or drug outcome is certified.

modules.title: Verification Register
modules.description: Typed, bounded receipt validation and negative tests; no independent research replication is claimed.

modules.title: Resource Estimator
modules.description: Qualtran logical resource analysis and physical overhead assumptions require a separate reviewed experiment.

modules.title: Noise and Calibration Lab
modules.description: Bounded local Bell-state readout-bit-flip toy model with analytical probability checks; not physical quantum calibration, quantum error correction or a hardware result.

modules.title: Hybrid Optimization Lab
modules.description: Classical MIP/CP-SAT and heuristics must remain the baseline before QAOA-style experiments.

modules.title: Hardware Execution Gateway
modules.description: External hardware credentials, spending, outbound access and execution are disabled.
